clips.title: The story
paras: Near Brill, Elder Graveborn greets travelers during the Lunar Festival. The ancestral spirit honors them and points pilgrims toward other elders in northern Lordaeron.

Elder Graveborn greets travelers just southeast of Brill during the Lunar Festival. The spectral elder stands among the haunted woods of Tirisfal Glades, where the Forsaken town lies nearby. Though the kingdom is troubled, Graveborn offers pilgrims peaceful greetings and ancestral wisdom. He also points them toward spirits in the Undercity, the Sepulcher, and across the Plaguelands.
